         9                  ACTING PRESIDENT WINNER:    The

        10       invocation today will be given by the Reverend

        11       Peter G. Young, Mother Theresa Community in

        12       Albany.

        13                  Father?

        14                  REVEREND YOUNG:    Thank you,

        15       Senator.

        16                  Let us pray.

        17                  Today is a special session, and we

        18       have a need for special prayers.  Because in

        19       this special time, we know that we're in an

        20       economic crisis.  And in our vocation, as we

        21       have today, we call then for our trust in God.

        22       Examples of past leaders from this Senate

        23       chamber -- too, too many to name -- we know

        24       that they have done it, and we can do it.

        25                  We need to respond to assist all of



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       our New York State citizens with pride of what

         2       being a Senator in New York State and this

         3       Empire State is all about.  In our historic

         4       tradition and in difficult times of

         5       Revolutionary War, Civil War, world wars, and

         6       of economic depressions in the 1880s and the

         7       1930s, everyone came to the rescue and to the

         8       recall of being a citizen and a Senator with

         9       pride.

        10                  Our Senators are therefore

        11       challenged to accept the responsibilities of

        12       leadership beyond their party lines to help

        13       others and New York State citizens for that

        14       better kind of life.

        15                  Amen.

         3                  "Pursuant to the power vested in me

         5       I hereby convene the Legislature in

         6       Extraordinary Session, at the Capitol, in the

         7       City of Albany, on the 18th day of November,

         8       2008, at 12 o'clock noon, for the purpose of

         9       considering a complete plan of legislation to

        10       implement budgetary savings; and for the

        11       consideration of legislation with respect to

        12       such other subjects as I may recommend.

        13                  "Given under my hand and the Privy

        14       Seal of the State in the City of Albany this

        15       29th day of October in the year 2008.

        16                  "By the Governor, David A.

        17       Paterson."
